tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi smon lam mdo sde'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swā sti/ lha yi lha mchog rgyal ba shākya thub/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi bya rgod phung por bzhugs/ /dgra bcom dge 'dun byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ / srid gsum che dgu'i tshogs kyis zhabs la gtugs/ /de tshe shā ri'i bu yis gsol btab nas/ /'gro la phan phyir chos kyi sgron me spar/ /bdag kyang dang ba'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /yang dag smon lam 'di dag 'grub par shog / 'di nas shar phyogs logs su stong gsum stong*/ /'das pa'i pha rol mngon par dga' ba zhes/ /yon tan gzhal du med pa'i zhing khams yod/ /bdag cag zhing der chos la spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jug pa dang*/ /spyod pa mchog dang spro ba chen po dang*/ /sems mchog bskyed dang go cha bgo ba dang*/ /yon tan brjod pa'i tshul la 'jug par shog /sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan chen pos/ /phar phyin drug las brtsams te chos 'khor bskor/ /de tshe mchog tu gyur ba'i dge slong zhig /byang chub spyod pa mchog la dam bca' mdzad/ /gnod sems mi skye rkyen gyis mi 'khrugs pas/ /de nas brtsams te rgyal sras gnas skabs dang*/ /da lta rgyal bar gyur kyang mi 'khrugs zhes/ /bla na med pa'i mtshan mchog don ldan gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs de nyid la'ang*/ /snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po khyed ltar dam bca' smon lam 'debs/ khyed kyi mdzad spyod rjes su bdag slob shog /g.yo sgyu med cing bden pas sems bskyed la/ khro dang gnod sems 'khrug pa thams cad spangs/ /nam yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems mi 'bral/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs spangs/ /srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i sems dang bral/ /rtag tu bla med byang chub yongs su bsngo/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin bgyid pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yid byed 'bral med sgom par shog /tshe rabs kun tu rab tu byung nas kyang*/

/'dod chung chog shes sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /chags pa med pa'i spobs pas dam chos ston/ /bag med le los nyal ba nam yang med/ /rtsa ltung spangs shing khyim gyi las mi bskyed/ / bud med brdzun dang gzhan skyon brjod pa dang*/ /gzhan gnod dpa' skong la sogs mi bgyid cing*/ /bden don spyod tshe ngan spyod spong bar shog /tha na ngur smrig tshun la'ang mchod rten dang*/ /blo ldan kun la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ / dam chos nyan par brtson zhing lha gzhan spangs/ /chos dang zang zing rtag tu snyoms par gtong*/ /srog la'ang mi lta gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sems/ /rmi lam du'ang tshul khrims 'chal ba spangs/ /gang na nyes ltung sgra yang mi grags pa'i/ / zhing mchog yongs su dag pa sgrub par shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i myu gur gyur pa na/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i smon lam go cha mdzad/ /dam bca' 'di 'dra ldan pa'i rgyal sras rnams/ /bla med byang chub nye zhes rgyal bas bsngags/ /bden pa'i mthu las 'jig rten khams kyang g.yos/ /kye ma sngon med seng ge'i sgra chen zhes/ /'jig rten kun tu bsngags pa lan brgyar brjod/ /bdag cag rnams kyang de bzhin spyod par shog /rgyal gzhan sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad pa na/ / 'od kyi snang bas 'jig rten kun khyab ste/ /sdug bsngal kun zhi ngo mtshar dpag med 'byung*/ khyed ni thugs bskyed tsam na'ang de dang mtshungs/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' stong la sogs/ /'phags mchog bgrang yas las kyang ches lhag ces/ /slob pa'i dus na'ang sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /bdag kyang mgon po khyed dang mtshungs par shog /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i byang chub shing*/ /gnam 'phang du ni dpag tshad 'bum yod la/ /rin chen sna bdun las grub de las ni/ rab tu snyan pa'i chos sgra mtha' yas 'byung*/ /bskal pa chen po 'bum phrag bcu yi bar/ /bcom ldan 'tsho zhing bzhes la chos kyang ston// phyi rjes bstan pa'ang yun tshad de tsam gnas/

/de 'dra'i rgyal ba rtag tu mthong bar shog /byang chub brnyes par 'gyur ba'i zhag bdun sngon/ /'gro kun dga' bdes khyab cing nyon mongs bral/ /bla med ye shes brnyes tshe khams gsum g.yo/ /kun gyi phyag 'tshal mchod pa dpag yas phul/ /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad can nor bu'i gdugs/ /rtag tu dbu gtsug steng gi nam mkhar gnas/ /stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten khams de ni/ /sku yi 'od zer kho nas rtag tu khyab/ / zhing khams de na ngan 'gro bdud las dang*/ /mu stegs can dang 'thab rtsod 'ching ba med/ /rgas dang nad dang rgud pa yongs med cing*/ /bud med skyon dang mi gtsang dngos po med/ /nyan thos rnams kyang theg chen tshul la bsten/ /bden pa mthong ba'i mod la dgra bcom thob/ /dge slong dge 'dun bkod pa mtha' med cing*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa tshad med de/ /de dag re re'i yon tan bgrang las 'das/ /bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /tshogs mchog dam pa de 'dra'i nang chud nas/ /chos kyi sgo yi ting 'dzin thob par shog/ mdog bzang sa gzhi 'jam la reg na bde/ /mtho dman med cing lha yi nor bus spras/ /gser gyi pad+ma mang pos rab tu khebs/ /sdong dum tsher ma ngam grog la sogs spangs/ /gos dang rgyan rnams dpag bsam shing las 'byung*/ /'bad rtsol med par rin chen snod rnams su/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas 'dod bzhin 'byung*/ khyim rnams thams cad gzhal med khang pa ste/ khri dang mal gdan yo byad du mas khyab/ /rdzing bu gser gyi bye ma brdal ba las/ /mya ngan med pa'i ljon pas yongs su bskor/ /de dag skyes bu'i 'dod la rjes su 'byung*/ /'jam po'i rlung ldang tsha grang sdug bsngal med/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal po las/ /gtso 'khor gzhan med thams cad snyoms par bde/ /nyo tshong zhing sogs las la mi 'jug ste/ /ji ltar yid la bsam pa de ltar 'byung*/ /gser gyi ta la'i nags kyis phyogs kun khyab/

/yid 'ong sgra dang dri zhim kun tu 'thul/ /glu gar rol mos brtse yang bag yod ldan/ /mgon khyod spyod yul gshegs na zhabs kyi rjes/ /rin chen chu skyes 'dab stong ldan pa 'byung*/ /pad+ma de yang mchod yul chen por 'gyur/ /'dzam bu gling nas sum cu rtsa gsum bar/ /gser dngul baiḍūr+ya yi them skas can/ /de la lha dang mi rnams bde bar rgyu/ /ji ltar lha bzhin de ltar mi yang bde/ /lha rnams 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la smon/ /dbang sgyur bdud kyi 'jig rten zhes grags na'ang*/ /yang dag lam la zhugs pa kho na yin/ /'gro ba thams cad bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa/ /rtag par mchod la brtson zhing chos kyang nyan/ /thams cad kun nas nyon mongs shas chung zhing*/ /sdig pa'i las dang nyes ltung dri mas dben/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba las kyang chags bral thob/ /mngal gnas khang bzang lta bur zhag bdun bde/ /nyan thos rnams kyang rnam 'phrul zad mi mnga'/ /sems pa rnams kyi rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ /zhing khams mchog de'i chos kyi 'byor bas ni/ /zhing gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /thugs rje ldan pa spos kyi glang po ni/ /da lta skyob pa mchog gi rgyal tshab lags/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i phyi rjes su/ /zhag bdun lon nas chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa gser gyi pad+ma zhes/ /stobs bcu ldan pa mi 'khrugs ji lta ba/ /thugs rje'i 'phrin las bsam mi khyab par 'gyur/ /mgon po de ni mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan khyod kyi mdzad spyod ji lta bar/ /byang chub spyod pa sgrub par dam 'cha' zhing*/ /mi 'khrugs nyid dang lhan cig 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa dang*/ khyod sku dam chos gsung ba'i rnam pa dang*/ /dge slong dge 'dun dran dang rgyal sras kyi/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran nas yongs su bsngo/ /de dag mngon dga'i zhing du skyes bar gsungs/

/rgyal tshab dam pa'i mtshan thos smon lam 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dag par sgrub pa dang*/ /gzhan dag zhing der smon lam 'debs su 'jug /mi 'khrugs zhing gi mdo sder spyod pa dang*/ /glang po'i khri dang pad+ma la bzhugs pa'i/ /sku gzugs stong phrag sgrub par byed pa sogs/ khyed sku bgrang yas dge 'dun tshogs kyis bskor/ /mngon sum mthong nas zhing der 'gro bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas bden pa'i tshig gis de skad gsungs/ /'gro ba kun kyang rnam pa de lta bus/ /bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs la rab zhugs nas/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing la spyod par shog /bdag cag deng nas skye ba thams cad du/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i dpal la longs spyod cing*/ /rnam gsum sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams drungs phyung nas/ /mi 'khrugs mgon po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston mchog rol bas/ /'gro kun bla med bde la 'god par shog / ces pa mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi smon lam mdo sde'i dgongs don zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer mang pos bskul pa'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// // maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi smon lam mdo sde'i dgongs don bzhugs/ -PAGE 336--PAGE 335--PAGE 331-
